searchText: Hey <@&1416139337179074590>! I think it'd be a good idea to scope 8250 and 8272 for `frames-devnet-1`. The sooner we do this, the better, since all efforts on specifying FOCIL + Frames take them into account. It'd be ideal to have them as part of the next devnet sgtm added to next week's agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2241 updated: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/frames-devnet-1 Whats the time frame we want to launch this? IMO it’d be either next week or the week after the next frames breakout (two weeks from now). If we have 3 clients ready then we can target next week, but if not, we can announce the devnet-1 intent next breakout so clients have enough time to implement it, aiming to launch the week after next breakout call. If we can go with 2 clients, then AFAIK nethermind and us should be ready. There’s still an important spec change under review in the EIPs repo, but one week should be enough for that PR to get merged and us implementing that change Edit: just realized that we’d need execution spec tests for them, so maybe we have some more delay there

excerpts.author: ivanlitteri
excerpts.content:
IMO it’d be either next week or the week after the next frames breakout (two weeks from now).

If we have 3 clients ready then we can target next week, but if not, we can announce the devnet-1 intent next breakout so clients have enough time to implement it, aiming to launch the week after next breakout call. 

If we can go with 2 clients, then AFAIK nethermind and us should be ready. There’s still an important spec change under review in the EIPs repo, but one week should be enough for that PR to get merged and us implementing that change

Edit: just realized that we’d need execution spec tests for them, so maybe we have some more delay there
